question.text: In an oligopeptide named Alanylglycylphenyl alanyl isoleucine, the number of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>sp</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> hybridised carbons is _____.

solution.text:
An oligopeptide is a short-chain peptide. The given oligopeptide is a tripeptide.

The given Oligopeptide has the following structure

In sp2 hybridisation carbon can have one pi bond. The carbons marked with * are sp2 carbons

It has 10 sp2 hybridised C atoms.
